summary: Snail, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that the Nasdaq Hearings Panel granted its request to continue listing its Class A Common Stock on The Nasdaq Capital Market, subject to demonstrating compliance with the Equity Rule (minimum stockholders' equity of $2,500,000) by filing timely public disclosure. The company had earlier received a delisting determination for noncompliance with the Minimum Bid Price Requirement, which it regained on July 21, 2026 after a reverse stock split. The Panel reserves the right to reconsider terms. Watch for the company's disclosure of transactions to achieve equity compliance.
